title: Digital Employee Experience Monitoring

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Digital Employee Experience Monitoring": Measure application responsiveness, logins and meeting quality from device and network data to find group-level problems and fix them, with data aggregated to groups and never used to rank employees. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Individual scores.
